strings.en: I-Inez...... About Ai...
...The "I" in Inez stands for "Ai."
Heh heh heh... At the colony, she got caught up in your Boson Jump, Akito.
Huh?
She was flung back to ancient Mars...
and there, the people who built these ruins sent her back.
But in all the chaos just now, she was made to jump again,
this time into the desert 20 years ago......
Cast out into the Martian desert, she lost her memory from the shock.
She was found by Nergal staff searching the area, and eventually...
That's enough!
...I'm sorry, Ai. I couldn't save you...
...We finally meet again, Big Bro...
...Captain Misumaru, come here.
Huh?
Never mind, just come here too.
You should be able to Boson Jump. Come at once!
Y-Yes!
C-Captain!?
Yurika! She vanished...!?
A Boson Jump...! Near the ruins, it's this easy...
The Captain appears to have materialized inside the ruins.
Ms. Fressange, I'd like an explanation...
Gladly. Using Tenkawa's Aestivalis, we will now
extract the core of these ruins... the calculation unit.
So you're gonna wreck the ruins after all!?
Don't worry.
In these ruins, there's no distinction between space and time...
So it should keep working even when detached.
How convenient.
Then the three of us, who can trigger Boson Jumps, will send the core...
somewhere beyond the reach of us... and of the Jovians.
I get it! You'll send just the important part where nobody can reach it!
Is that... even possible?
It should be... Or rather, to keep the ruins intact
and out of everyone's hands... that's the only way.
Aw, man... Couldn't you just leave it to Nergal?
Well then, let's begin.
Can we really send it away?
Hey now, don't tell us that after making us wait this long.
In theory.
The ruins are made entirely
of the same material as the Tulip crystals, after all.
All we can do now is believe... in the ruins... in their power...
Ruri, begin.
The rest... is in their hands...
Yes... All we can do is pray it goes well.
Captain Misumaru and the others will surely...
Has the transfer of the ruins begun?
With this... there'll be no more reason to go after these ruins...
If the fighting with Jupiter ends...
*Gulp*...
Nothing's... happening...!?
Hey, what's the deal!? Hurry it up!
Hmmmm...
...Captain, Tenkawa, you two need to kiss.
Whaaaaat!?
Whaaaaat!?
Why does it have to be a kiss!?
What? Sounds like fun!
Kiss, kiss!
Unlike a Tulip, where the field is already open from the start,
making the ruins jump out of nowhere naturally takes a strong field.
For that, we need more electrical contact, so to speak...
or mucous membrane contact, so to speak...
A kiss... huh...
Yep.
Hey, Rom.
Do Earthlings power up when they kiss?
Hmm... I've never heard of it... But if their bond is strong, perhaps.
A bond... You mean people who are close?
...Hey, Mia, Lamba! You try it.
What!?
No way! We're both girls! And something weird might awaken!
Then... Joe and Mike!
Huh!?
Wait, us!? At least make it a guy and a girl!
W-Well... I think this is probably a special case...
If they don't hurry, everyone's in trouble. The Jovians might come back.
...New enemies could arrive at any moment. Hurry.
No!
Y-Yurika...
No means no! Absolutely not!!
This is no time to be saying that.
Y-Yeah, it's not like we've got a choice.
Not like we've got a choice!?
...Then why don't you just go kiss Inez, Akito!
What is this footage?
Sounded like some kind of lovers' quarrel over the comms...
By the way, we're also sending live footage from inside the ruins
on Jovian frequencies.
So the Jovian pilots who escaped can see it too, huh?
Yikes, that's reckless.
But listening to this would take the fight out of anyone.
What are you thinking!? Why are you being so stubborn!?
Because you've got Inez... You've got Ai...
Wh-What are you talking about!?
You feel responsible for Inez, don't you, Akito...
So I...
Idiot!
Waaaaah!
That's mean... You didn't have to hit me...
Yurika... I watched the last episode of Gekiganger 3.
Huh?
Before the sortie, Gai made me watch it...
And man, it was a terrible story...
Hey, Tenkawa, what's that supposed to...!
Just shut up and listen!
Yeah, yeah, leave it to Akito.
Leave it to Tenkawa... Leave him what?
It was a terrible story... But it gave me chills...
The part where Gekiganger 3 and Gekiganger V fight together...
So that means... you do love it?
I want to believe in how I felt... back when I loved Gekiganger...
how I felt when I believed in hot blood. So...
So you love me, Akito.
H-Here I was, trying to say something grand...!
Y-Yeah, I do. Got a problem with that?
Nope.
Good grief, looks like they've finally worked it out.
Look who's talking, Domon.
You were plenty slow on the uptake yourself... Right, Rain?
Y-Yes, well......
Yurika... W-What about you?
Me? I... I love you, Akito!
...That's enough.
Nadesico, Ruri Hoshino. Cut the line.
But it's just getting to the good part?
...Don't be tactless.
You're quite the romantic, Nanbu.
Apparently men are best that way. ...Cut it.
Exactly.
Besides, you're just a kid, aren't you, Ruri? You said so yourself.
...I slipped up. Roger.
"Love you"... That's the first time I've heard you say it.
No way...
It's true.
Akito... I love you......
Jump field generated. Boson reaction increasing.
Ruins calculation unit transferring. Destination coordinates unknown...
Now there's no reason left to fight over these ruins, is there?
What a romantic way to send something off... Ugh... ugh...
Pai? What's wrong?
Don't tell me you got hurt escaping from the peace talks!?
It's not that... It's nothing... Nothing...
...Couldn't it at least have transferred to our head office...
If you made a business out of it, it'd get out and start another war.
Captain Akiyama! That transmission just now...
We heard it too! ...Tsukiomi, this means...
Yes... They got us good...
How could this happen... This means...
Bright, it should be all right now.
All right... Attention, Jovian Alliance forces.
This is Bright Noa of the Earth Federation Forces' Londo Bell team.
As you just heard...
the ruins' calculation unit has been transferred somewhere in space.
There is no longer any reason to fight over these ruins.
Nonsense!
You think you can deceive us with such lies!?
Then whether you believe it or not is up to you.
We're withdrawing. You're free to investigate the ruins as you please.
...Hurry and recover Ms. Inez.
I only hope... this is our last battle with the Jovian Alliance.
Me too... I really hope the fighting ends...
No kidding.
I've had enough war on our Mars.
I wonder what the Jovians are gonna do...
Eh, if they come at us again, we'll fight back. Simple as that.
For now, all we can do is hope they understand how we feel...
Lieutenant General Kusakabe...
...Ngh... All forces, prepare to withdraw...
(Tsukumo... The justice I sought, even if it meant shooting you... its outcome
is this...!?)
You're telling me this whole battle was for nothing!?
Calm down, Tsukiomi, I feel the same! But for now...
No! Akiyama... you could never understand how I feel!
...No one... No one understands how I feel...!
What are you doing!? Prepare to withdraw!!
(...Disposing of Shiratori seems to have hit him harder than expected...)
...Captain Akiyama.
Hm, what is it, Saburota?
Enemy or not, mid-battle or not, that lovers' talk somehow...
it struck a chord in my heart, differently from Gekiganger.
What kind of slack talk is that!?
M-My apologies, sir!
...But it's true, listening to that exchange,
my anger and hatred toward the Earthlings seemed to fade away.
Ha ha ha! Only natural, I suppose.
Come to think of it, we Jovians were Earthlings to begin with!
Sir... That's right, sir!
(Tsukumo... I'm going to take another hard look at my own justice.
And to do that...)
...That is the current situation on Mars.
...Can you confirm the Jovian movements from your end?
Yes.
They've withdrawn from Martian space and the Earth Sphere.
Well done, Bright. It's all thanks to you.
No... This operation was planned by Ms. Fressange
and carried out by Captain Misumaru and the others...
I-I see.
...Yurikaaa... It's not just your body, you've really grown up~
My body has nothing to do with it!
Besides... all I did for the operation was... kiss... Akito...
Wh-What!? Yurika! What did you just say!?
N-Now, now, Admiral Misumaru,
perhaps family matters can wait for another time...
About our response to the Jovian Alliance...
Ah...! *Ahem*!
Yes, as for our response to the Jovian Alliance,
the Federation government also wishes to pursue peaceful dialogue,
including a look into the past. However...
The Federation government itself is still in a vacuum, you mean...
And we'd finally managed to get them to withdraw to their home base...
The priority is to resolve the other problems first
and stabilize the Federation.
Thanks to your efforts, many of the threats are gone, but...
There's still the Bunker space pirates, and the mysterious Einst...
And though it's unconfirmed, the revived Emperor Muge...
Nothing but tough customers.
I truly am sorry to put this on you...
but Earth has its hands full rebuilding from the devastation.
Your supplies will get top priority where possible. Please hang in there.
...Understood. Please don't overdo it either, Admiral...
Mm...
Yurika, be a help to Captain Bright and Commander Hazuki.
Okaaay! Take care, Father!
And you're Princess Romina and Rom, I believe.
On behalf of all humanity in the Earth Sphere,
I thank you for your kindness. Thank you.
No, the thanks are ours...
The people of Earth have helped us many times.
Now it's simply our turn to lend Earth's people our strength.
We all live in the same universe,
and our will to stand against evil is the same.
No, no...
How many humans could say that with their heads held high...
We're counting on you from here on, too.
...Well then, Captain Bright, I'm counting on you.
Understood.
Londo Bell will continue its operations.
Bye, Father!
Listen, Yurika!
Next time, you're going to explain what you said to Daddy properly!
Oh, Father! I'm not a child anymore...!
...Seems Earth has its hands full with reconstruction.
And thanks to that, the fighting's left to us, huh?
Damian, you mustn't say such things...
But that's also the truth.
...Still, Damian, it's only natural to look to what's closest first...
Earth's reconstruction comes first again, huh...
(Like the cleanup after the last war... Some things never change...)
Well then...
The war with the Jovian Lizards seems to have calmed down for now,
and Earth seems to be working hard on rebuilding.
So let's keep the Nadesico going strong!
If we'd gotten the ruins' technology, I'd be twice as motivated...
There's no use saying that now.
If we don't wrap up the rest fast, we'll miss the reconstruction boom.
Quick to switch gears, as expected.
I may be vice-helmsman, but I was the Chairman's secretary first.
I'd like our main helmsman back as soon as possible.
Come to think of it, I wonder how Shiratori's doing...
No problems there.
...!! Minato! And Shiratori too!
Ah ha ha, sorry about that. Shiratori scolded me, too.
"You have important duties, yet you're
nursing someone like me!?" he said.
I-I wasn't scolding you!
It's just, neglecting important duties for a man like me...
Okay, okay, spare us the mush! Anyway, all's well that ends well!
Glad you're better, Shiratori.
Minato was worried sick, like she was the one dying.
Come on, don't be so tactless.
...Shiratori, um...
Yes. I heard about the Jovian Alliance. ......Captain Yurika Misumaru.
Y-Yes!
Please... please hire me as a pilot
of the phase transition reactor battleship Nadesico!
Whoa!
I knew it.
I hear the Jovians have withdrawn to Jupiter to watch the Earth Sphere...
If I, supposedly dead, returned, it would cause confusion...
and at worst, it could lead to civil war...
Come on, aren't you exaggerating...?
No... Genichiro and I... The man who shot me was my dearest friend...
That such a thing could happen... it showed me there's political
scheming even within the Jovian Alliance. I feel that keenly...
Shiratori...
Once the Nadeshiko battle is over, the Earth Sphere should stabilize.
A new chance for peace talks with the Jovian Alliance should follow.
That is when I'll reveal to Jupiter that I'm alive.
Until then, please take me on! I'm begging you!
M-Mr. Shiratori, you don't have to get down on your knees...
Captain...
No.
...! I see... Even if I was betrayed by my own side,
I was your enemy, so you can't trust me...
As a commander, that's the obvious call. But still...!
Captain!! Why...!?
I can't hire Mr. Shiratori.
For one thing, it'd cost money. Right, Mr. Prospector?
Eh... Oh! Y-Yes, quite right.
You may not have been aware, Major Shiratori,
but the Nadesico is, at heart, a privately run ship...
We simply can't take on extra expenses, mech upkeep included...
Heh heh heh... You're a sly one, Captain.
What...?
So, Mr. Shiratori, you're our guest. Do whatever you like.
But in battle, please follow Captain Bright's command, okay?
Wha...! Tsukumo Shiratori th-thanks you from the bottom of his heart!
As for maintaining your mech, since you've provided us its technology,
upkeep costs will be on the house. Is that acceptable, Chairman Akatsuki?
Fine by me, fine by me.
Besides, on the Nadesico I'm just a pilot.
If I don't follow Captain Misumaru's orders, she'll kick me off the ship.
Way to go, Captain! That's real class!
The captain's gracious call... the captain's... gall...
Meaning what?
All right, time to celebrate! Shiratori, come with me!
I'll show you those three lost episodes you were talking about!
Ohh! Gekiganger's lost episodes 9, 13 and 33!
Maybe I'll tag along too.
Then I'll watch too. It's been a while.
Ahh, I want to watch with Akito too...
Captain, shouldn't you report Mr. Shiratori to Captain Bright?
Ugh... Ruri, you're so mean...
I may be vice-helmsman, but I was the Chairman's secretary first.
I'd like our chief helmsman back on her feet as soon as possible.
You mean Minato...
Oh my, isn't the mood a bit gloomy in here?
...! Minato!
Ahaha, sorry about that. ...I'm fine now.
There's no point moping forever. Besides...
Besides...?
Someone in Londo Bell cheered me up.
Though I guess we're all part of Londo Bell now, huh? Hee hee...
Wow... Everyone's really keeping an eye on each other, huh?
So who cheered you up? Huh? Huh?
That's a se-cret. It's tactless to even ask.
Tactless... tack-less... no tacks on me, really...
Izumi, aren't your jokes getting weaker...?
Were they ever strong?
Pai! Wait!
Why are you leaving?
We finally finished fighting the Jovian Alliance and the Meganoids!
...Don't take it personally, Lamba.
I've found another way to live...!
That hurts, Pai! Let go of me!
The four of us belong together in Londo Bell!
...What, you can't fight without me?
If even one Dan Mechanic is missing... we can't form Dangaioh!
I won't let you go!
Hmph, talk all you want. If you can stop me... go ahead and try!
Why take Roll too? There's no reason to drag him into this!
Cheap little lasers and psychic powers you don't know how to use
aren't good enough for my partner!
Why!?
Why won't you stay with everyone in Londo Bell!?
Don't tell me... your memory...!?
...That's right... I'm going to find out who I really am...
So stay out of my way!
Then the four of us should go together!
...If my memory's right...
I'm going to be Londo Bell's enemy...
What!?
...No way!?
That's why only Roll and I are going...!
Wait! Don't go!
Mia! Lamba!
...Ah, they're gone... What does she mean, she'll be our enemy!?
Lamba! We're going after them!
What!? Mia, we're sortieing without permission...? Isn't that bad!?
This is no time to worry about that!
Hurry, Lamba! We'll lose them!
This feels like something the Cyber Beast Force would do!
Mia!? Waaah, hold on a sec!
Grand Captain Garimos...
What is it...?
It seems a single Dan Mechanic is heading our way...
A Dan Mechanic... Dangaioh's separated form...
Three more are following behind... apparently chasing the first...
So she's come back...
Don't lay a hand on them. Let them into this flagship...
Are you sure?
...They're the ones who betrayed the Bunker once, you know...?
The Bunker does not forgive traitors...!
...Then why...?
I want to see it...
The power of Tarsan's masterpiece, Dangaioh...
I know... If it proves useless...
you may do with it as you please.
Yes, Grand Captain Garimos...
What!? Pai's gone off on her own?
...And the rest of the Dangaioh team went after her...
Yes, so... we contacted you to ask if you had any idea where she went.
She hasn't come back here. ...But if there's one other place...
You have an idea?
...Pai may have gotten her memory back.
...Gotten her memory back?
Come to think of it, the Dangaioh kids had no memories, right?
Say she did get her memory back... Where the hell did she go?
Normally, I'd guess home... where she was born?
Where is Pai from, I wonder...?
It seems the doctor knows?
...This is hard to say...
but Pai... Dangaioh is heading for the Bunker...
What does that mean... Dr. Tarsan?
...It'd be better if you heard the details from her...
So many problems...
And what will the Dangaioh team do, I wonder?
Don't tell me they're going pirate hunting by themselves?
That's a bit much, even for them...
In any case, the Dangaioh team is heading for the Bunker, right?
No doubt about it...
Even if we go to help them...
Dr. Tarsan, do you know where the Bunker is?
I've been there once before... They haven't moved from that point since...
All right, we'll storm right in there ourselves...!
Hold on. Even if we storm in...
Hey, Amuro, don't tell me... you're getting cold feet?
Let's charge in all at once, like at the Hyakki fortress island!
Dr. Tarsan, I hear the enemy is a huge fleet tens of thousands strong?
That's right. Garimos's flagship sits right at its center.
...Cutting through all that to reach the flagship... It's not realistic.
...At the fortress island, there was only one place to break into.
Though that, too, was a reckless and absurd operation.
Then there's no guarantee the Dangaioh team is safe either...!?
But, y'know, if a horde that big... came at us all at once,
there's no way we could hold them all off, right?
Sooner or later we'll have to face them, so why not all at once...
...Tens of thousands... right...?
If we crush their head, we might manage somehow...
But before we can even get there,
just how many enemies will we have to take on...?
...Looks like you're finally grasping how fearsome the Bunker is.
...Same as I once did.
No matter how hard we fight, against tens of thousands...
Yes... we'd be crushed by sheer numbers.
No, battles aren't won by numbers! If we carve a path to their boss...!
Fool! What do you hope to do, leaping into the enemy's grasp with no plan!
That is what's called reckless valor!
But Master, even so, if we just sit here waiting for the enemy...!
Hold on, Domon. It seems we're not entirely without a plan.
Huh...?
...Princess Romina?
There is a way.
Huh? But Princess Romina, the enemy is...
What Burning just said... crush the head... ignore the enemies around it,
and board the enemy flagship. That's all we need, isn't it?
Hey, don't tell me... Princess Romina.
We'll use the micro-worm drive to slip right into the enemy's midst...!
No way! That's insane! What's gotten into you, Princess Romina!?
...It's something I'd been considering during the battle with Annex.
Only now the target has changed to the space pirates, the Bunker...
Hahahahaha! I like it, Princess Romina!
When did you get so gutsy, huh?
Oh... ah, Joe... I...
If that's decided... we've got no choice but to do it.
Yeah! Let's go wild out there...!
...Let's do it.
...A reckless plan. Perhaps we should stop them, Amuro.
Think you could stop them, Captain?
I see... You've done something like this once yourself... It can't be helped.
...Mr. Shaff, please contact the Nadesico as well.
...Now the question is whether they'll agree too.
Well, it's probably pointless to even ask.
